resource.name: KeibiDrop
resource.creator: KeibiSoft
resource.category: Productivity scripts, workflow bridges, and integrations
resource.description: Mounts remote shared media folders for on-demand editing, with a documented Resolve/NAS workflow. Supports desktop systems plus a separate Android app. Direct peer connections can fall back to a relay; network quality affects editing. Engine is MPL-2.0, while UI/mobile components have separate terms. Paid relay data packs are optional.
resource.access: Mixed: free direct sharing; optional relay data packs
resource.platformNotes: Provider-documented distribution targets; no installation testing. See description for platform and host caveats.

requirements.dependencies: Network connection and platform mount integration (FUSE/WinFsp)
